about.title: About FloodGuard
about.body: FloodGuard is the flood product in the TxBizFinder Intelligence suite. FEMA NFHL is national â€” look up any US ZIP. Started in Texas; coverage is USA where effective flood maps exist.
about.sources: Priority APIs: FEMA NFHL + NWS + USGS + OpenFEMA. Scrape only if a local layer is missing and not exposed officially. Never scrape weather.gov HTML or FEMA MSC UI.
about.catalogHint: Each source has a confidence badge (Official / Agency open data / Best-effort scrape / Modeled-demo) documented in suite meta.
about.suite: Sister apps: TxBizFinder, PermitRadar, ChannelWatch, Emissions Sentinel, PowerPulse, MapHub.
